title: RAGAM-AI: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning based Agentic approach powered by Generative AI for Edge Resource Management
abstract: arXiv:2611.06554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Resource management for distributed edge networks hosting different services has been handled efficiently using Reinforcement learning (RL). Reward generalization in complex workflows is still an open issue within the RL realm. Therefore, this work proposes RAGAM-AI, a hybrid framework that combines the capabilities of RL algorithms and Generative-AI (Gen-AI) for powering an Agentic AI workflow that optimizes resource allocation at the Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) units. This framework further resolves the reward generalization issue by utilizing Large Language Model (LLM) for feedback. A Multi- Agent Soft-Actor Critic (MASAC) using Math{\Sigma}tral as a reward oracle is implemented for managing resource allocations at the MEC. RAGAM-AI interprets system state information and evaluates multi-objective trade-offs guiding the resource orchestration loop over distributed edge server agents. translated_title: RAGAM-AI：一种由生成式AI驱动的混合强化学习智能体方法，用于边缘资源管理
translated_abstract: 对于托管多种服务的分布式边缘网络，强化学习（RL）已被高效地用于资源管理。然而，复杂工作流中的奖励泛化问题仍是RL领域的一个开放性难题。为此，本工作提出了RAGAM-AI，这是一个融合强化学习算法与生成式AI（Gen-AI）能力的混合框架，用于驱动一个智能体AI工作流，以优化多接入边缘计算（MEC）单元的资源分配。该框架通过利用大语言模型（LLM）提供反馈，进一步解决了奖励泛化问题。该工作实现了以MathΣtral作为奖励预言机的多智能体Soft-Actor-Critic（MASAC）算法来管理MEC处的资源分配。RAGAM-AI能够解读系统状态信息并评估多目标权衡，从而指导分布式边缘服务器智能体上的资源编排循环。该框架的复杂性被进一步……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出RAGAM-AI混合框架，将强化学习与生成式AI结合构建智能体工作流，利用LLM作为奖励预言机解决奖励泛化问题，以优化多接入边缘计算单元的资源分配。
